title: Engineering Binding Domains to Recognize Ligand-Bound Receptors Using Yeast Surface Display
author: Dobersberger, Sumesgutner, et al.
materials: Zymoprep Yeast Plasmid Miniprep II kit
Cooled micro centrifuge for 1.5–2.0 mL tubes

steps.title: Isolate yeast plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate plasmids from the yeast library using the Zymoprep Yeast Plasmid Miniprep II Kit, adding 8 µL Zymolyase and incubating for 3 h as per the manufacturer’s protocol; store isolated plasmid at –20 °C.

steps.title: Error‑prone PCR of plasmid inserts
steps.instruction: Set up a 50 µL error‑prone PCR (epPCR) reaction with: 6 µL DNA template, 0.5 µL Taq polymerase, 2.5 µL each of Primer 1 and Primer 2 (10 µM), 5 µL 10× Thermopol buffer, 1 µL dNTPs (10 mM), 1 µL 8‑oxo‑dGTP (100 µM), 1 µL dPTP (100 µM), and 30 µL ddH₂O. Cycle: 94 °C 3 min; 18 cycles of 94 °C 45 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Gel‑purify epPCR product
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 % preparative agarose gel, mix the PCR reaction with 10 µL 6× loading dye, load 8 µL GeneRuler 1 kb ladder (1:5 diluted), run at 120 V for 45 min, extract the band of the expected size using the Monarch DNA Gel Extraction Kit, and determine DNA concentration.

steps.title: Amplify purified insert with Q5 polymerase
steps.instruction: Set up a 100 µL Q5 PCR (2 × 100 µL master mix) containing 40 ng DNA template, 1 µL Q5 polymerase, 10 µL each of Primer 1 and Primer 2 (10 µM), 20 µL 5× Q5 buffer, 2 µL dNTPs (10 mM), and water to 100 µL. Cycle: 98 °C 3 min; 29 cycles of 98 °C 45 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Verify insert size on analytical gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 % analytical agarose gel, combine 5 µL PCR product with 1 µL 6× loading dye, load 8 µL GeneRuler 1 kb ladder (1:5 diluted), run at 120 V for 45 min to confirm correct size.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of PCR product
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product by ethanol precipitation as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 10 % of the reaction volume of 3 M sodium acetate, pH 5.2 (e.g., 20 µL to a 200 µL reaction).
Add twice the volume of 100 % ethanol (e.g., 400 µL).
Centrifuge at 18 000 g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL 70 % ethanol, mix briefly, centrifuge 18 000 g 5 min, discard supernatant.
Add 500 µL 100 % ethanol, mix briefly, centrifuge 18 000 g 5 min, discard supernatant.
Air‑dry the pellet with the lid open until no liquid remains (usually a few hours).
Dissolve the dried pellet in 10 µL sterile nuclease‑free water and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Linearize pCTCON2V vector
steps.instruction: Digest 20 µg pCTCON2V with SalI‑HF in 5 µL CutSmart buffer (10×) and 3 µL SalI‑HF (20 U/µL) up to 50 µL total; incubate at 37 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Double‑digest linearized vector
steps.instruction: Add to the SalI‑digested vector: 3.75 µL CutSmart buffer (10×), 1.5 µL BamHI‑HF (20 U/µL), 1.5 µL NheI‑HF (20 U/µL), and water to 87.5 µL total; incubate at 37 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Precipitate and analyze digested vector
steps.instruction: Precipitate the double‑digested vector and analyze it on an agarose gel using the same procedure described in steps 21‑22 (gel preparation, loading, electrophoresis).

steps.title: Prepare competent yeast cells (EBY100)
steps.instruction: Streak EBY100 on YPD agar and incubate 2–3 days; inoculate a single colony into 20 mL fresh YPD, shake >16 h at 30 °C; dilute culture to OD₆₀₀ 0.2 and grow to OD₆₀₀ 1.3–1.5 (4–6 h).

steps.title: Make yeast cells electrocompetent
steps.instruction: Harvest 50 mL culture at 2000 g for 3 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in 25 mL 100 mM lithium acetate, add 250 µL 1 M DTT (final 10 mM), incubate 30 °C, 180 rpm, 10 min; centrifuge 2000 g 3 min, resuspend in 25 mL ice‑cold sterile H₂O, centrifuge again, finally resuspend in 350–400 µL ice‑cold sterile H₂O (≈500 µL total). All subsequent steps on ice with chilled reagents.

steps.title: Electroporate yeast with insert and vector
steps.instruction: In a pre‑chilled tube combine 4 µg linearized pCTCON2V vector with the purified insert DNA (dissolved in 10 µL sterile nuclease‑free water), add 250 µL electrocompetent cells, transfer to a pre‑chilled 2 mm cuvette, electroporate (Bio‑Rad Gene Pulser Xcell, square wave, 500 V, 15 ms), immediately add 0.5 mL pre‑warmed YPD, rinse cuvette with another 0.5 mL YPD, keep on a 30 °C heat block until all samples are processed, then incubate 30 °C for 1 h without shaking.

steps.title: Determine library diversity
steps.instruction: Serially dilute the recovered yeast in SD‑CAA, plate dilutions to count transformants (expected 1 × 10⁶–1 × 10⁸ colonies); plate 100 µL of 10⁻¹, 10⁻², and 10⁻³ dilutions of the “cells only” and “vector only” controls on SD‑CAA plates and incubate 30 °C for 2–3 days.

steps.title: Grow transformed library
steps.instruction: Centrifuge remaining cells at 2000 g for 3 min, resuspend in 200 mL SD‑CAA, and shake at 30 °C for >16 h. (Library can be induced the next day or passaged further as needed.)

steps.title: Isolate plasmids from yeast library for cloning
steps.instruction: Use the Zymoprep Yeast Plasmid Miniprep II Kit as described in step 1 to isolate plasmid DNA from the enriched yeast library.

steps.title: Electroporate plasmids into E. coli
steps.instruction: Thaw NEB 10‑beta electrocompetent cells on ice (10 min), mix 25 µL cells with 1 µL isolated plasmid, transfer to a chilled 1 mm cuvette, electroporate (Bio‑Rad Gene Pulser Xcell, exponential decay, 2.0 kV, 200 Ω, 25 µF; time constant ≈4.8–5.1 ms), immediately add 975 µL pre‑warmed NEB outgrowth medium, pipette up/down twice, transfer to a tube, flush cuvette with medium, incubate 37 °C, 300 rpm for 1 h.

steps.title: Plate transformed E. coli
steps.instruction: Spread 10 µL, 100 µL, and the remaining culture (after a brief centrifugation) onto pre‑warmed LB‑Amp plates; incubate >16 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Sequence single colonies
steps.instruction: Pick individual colonies, isolate plasmid DNA, and perform Sanger sequencing; analyze sequences and select clones based on desired amino‑acid composition.

steps.title: Transform selected plasmids into yeast
steps.instruction: Transform the chosen plasmids into S. cerevisiae EBY100 using the Frozen‑EZ Yeast Transformation II Kit per the manufacturer’s instructions; spread 50 µL and the residual transformation mixture on SD‑CAA plates and incubate 30 °C for 2–3 days.

steps.title: Grow yeast transformants
steps.instruction: Inoculate a single colony into 5 mL SD‑CAA, grow at 30 °C, 180 rpm for >16 h; dilute to OD₆₀₀ 0.3 in 5 mL SD‑CAA and grow to OD₆₀₀ 0.8–1.3.

steps.title: Induce surface expression
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cells (2000 g, 3 min, 25 °C), discard supernatant, resuspend in 5 mL SG‑CAA, incubate 20 °C, 180 rpm for >16 h.

steps.title: Prepare cells for staining
steps.instruction: Measure OD₆₀₀, centrifuge the required volume at 2000 g, 3 min, 4 °C, discard supernatant; wash cells with 1 mL PBSA, centrifuge and discard supernatant; resuspend cells and transfer 3 × 10⁶ cells in 25 µL to a V‑bottom 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Bind antigen (EGFR‑Fc) ± ligand
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of 30 nM EGFR‑Fc either alone (EGFR‑only) or pre‑incubated with 200 nM EGF (EGFR + EGF) to achieve final concentrations of 15 nM EGFR‑Fc and 100 nM EGF; incubate 60 min at 4 °C on a plate shaker.

steps.title: Wash after antigen binding
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cells, discard supernatant, wash with 200 µL PBSA (for EGFR‑only) or PBSA‑EGF (for EGFR + EGF); repeat centrifugation and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Stain with detection antibodies
steps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 25 µL of a mixture containing 1:40 diluted Penta‑His antibody and 1:500 diluted anti‑HA antibody (different fluorophores) prepared in the same buffer used for the previous wash (PBSA or PBSA‑EGF); incubate 20 min at 4 °C on a plate shaker.

steps.title: Final washes before flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Centrifuge, discard supernatant, wash with 200 µL PBSA (or PBSA‑EGF), centrifuge again, discard supernatant, keep the pellet on ice.

steps.title: Resuspend for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 100 µL PBSA or PBSA‑EGF immediately before acquisition on the flow cytometer (gating as shown in Figure 2A).
